messages:
maria: Quick share — I ran the microburst coalescing + smoothing-window sweep across regions. Need a fast read on p50/p95/p99 deltas and whether the scheduler tweak fixed the tail in ap-southeast-1.
bench-bot: Sweep summary: batch_window_ms=[8,20,40], max_batch_tokens=[512,1024], GPUs=[H100,A10G,L4], regions=[us-west-2,eu-west-1,ap-southeast-1]. Topline: coalescing reduced avg latency ~12-18% and increased throughput 6-22% for H100/A10G. L4 in ap-southeast-1 shows p99 regressions (~+120ms). Dashboard: https://dashboards.internal/bench/1815038420 :chart_with_upwards_trend:
bench-bot: sample numbers (tokens/sec and latencies):
```
H100 us-west-2  max_tokens=1024 window=20 -> throughput 45k tok/s, p50 32ms, p95 110ms, p99 210ms
A10G eu-west-1  max_tokens=1024 window=20 -> throughput 18k tok/s, p50 48ms, p95 180ms, p99 320ms
L4 ap-southeast-1 max_tokens=512  window=20 -> throughput 7.6k tok/s, p50 120ms, p95 420ms, p99 980ms (regression vs baseline)
```
jon: Hmm that L4 p99 spike looks like a kernel fallback under microbursts. Any kernel-selection logs?
akash: I dug into the run logs — on L4 we fall back to the generic softmax kernel when batched token variance > threshold. That matches the tail. Possible causes: sequence-length variance + small coalesced batches causing atomic kernel to be disabled.
priya: Maybe the smoothing-window (we called it "prefill smoothing") caused wider variance in per-request token counts. Suggest we try: batch_window_ms in {6,12,24,48}, max_batch_tokens {512,1536,3072}, and fairness_weight sweep {0.1,0.5,1.0}. Also overlay kv-prefetch hit rates.
maria: Good. Action items: @jon do a kernel-sweep on L4 (force atomic kernels / force generic) and compare p99s; @akash check kv-prefill hit/miss and per-request seq-length distribution; @priya add an overlay in the bench dashboard for kernel selection and prefill-hit. Run CI runs in low-traffic window (US night). :eyes: :white_check_mark:
jon: On it — I'll run forced-kernel experiments tonight and post traces.
bench-bot: Scheduled runs: kernel-sweep-L4 (force-atomic, force-generic) queued for 2026-11-17T02:00Z, batch-window sweep queued for 2026-11-17T03:30Z. Run IDs: br-1815038420-kernel, br-1815038420-window.
akash: Quick patch idea — lower the kernel-variance threshold and increase atomic re-use TTL. That might avoid fallback during microbursts. I'll prototype branch and test.
priya: I'll add a p99 regression alert for ap-southeast-1 L4 and pin the dashboard with before/after overlays.
maria: Perfect. Keep updates here once runs finish. If L4 still regresses, we'll consider region routing (prefer A10G/H100) for latency-sensitive tiers until kernel heuristics are stable. :shipit: 
jon: Will report back with traces and a short diff of kernel timings.
maria: Thanks all — tidy thread, please avoid posting large raw files here, link dashboards instead.
